MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream is an overnight facial moisturiser formulated with avocado, aloe vera, Vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and Kojic Acid. This Korean-inspired night cream is designed to support soft, smooth and radiant-looking skin as part of a consistent evening routine.

What is Avocado Korean Night Cream?

MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream is a cosmetic moisturising cream made for evening use. Its creamy texture helps leave skin feeling comfortable overnight, while the formula supports a brighter, smoother and more even-looking complexion. It is not intended to treat medical skin conditions.

For customers building a simple Korean-inspired routine, this night cream for glowing skin fits after cleansing and any lightweight leave-on products. It is designed for adults who want nourishing, brightening-focused skincare without overstating what a cosmetic product can do.

Key ingredients in this avocado night cream

Avocado and aloe vera for a comfortable skin feel

Avocado is valued in skincare for its nourishing, conditioning feel. Aloe vera is widely used in cosmetic formulas that aim to leave skin feeling hydrated and comfortable. Together, they make this glutathione-free avocado cream a practical choice for an overnight moisturising step.

Vitamin B3 and Kojic Acid skincare support

Vitamin B3, also called niacinamide, is a familiar ingredient in Vitamin B3 skincare. Kojic Acid is commonly included in cosmetic brightening formulas. This kojic acid cream is formulated to help improve the appearance of uneven-looking skin and support a fresh, radiant-looking finish with regular use.

For general ingredient education, see the American Academy of Dermatology’s skincare routine guidance.

Benefits of MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream

With regular use as part of a suitable routine, this brightening cream may help support:

  • Overnight moisturising and conditioning care
  • Soft, smooth and comfortable-looking skin
  • A brighter-looking, more even-looking complexion
  • A Korean-inspired brightening skincare routine
  • A simple final step in an evening skincare routine

Individual results vary with skin type, lifestyle and routine consistency. If you are introducing a new cosmetic product, a patch test is a sensible first step.

How to use Avocado Korean Night Cream

  1. Cleanse your face with a gentle cleanser and pat dry.
  2. Apply any lightweight products you already use in your evening routine.
  3. Take a small amount of MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream.
  4. Massage an even layer over the face, avoiding the immediate eye area.
  5. Leave on overnight and follow your usual morning routine.

Use this night cream in the evening. If your routine includes brightening ingredients, use broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day. Start gradually if you have sensitive skin or use several active skincare products.

Who is this night cream suitable for?

MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream is designed for adults seeking daily moisturising night care, avocado and aloe vera skincare, or a Korean-inspired brightening skincare routine. It may suit those looking for a glutathione face cream alternative with avocado, Vitamin B3 and Kojic Acid.

It is formulated for cosmetic skincare use. Stop use if irritation occurs, and seek professional advice for persistent skin concerns.

What to expect from Avocado Korean Night Cream

The first night. Skin feels softer and more comfortable the next morning.

After one week. Dry patches begin to settle and skin looks more hydrated.

After four to eight weeks. With nightly use and daily sunscreen, skin looks smoother and more even.

These are typical timelines for a cosmetic moisturiser. Your own results depend on your skin and on how consistently you use it.

How to use it for your skin type

Dry skin. Apply a full pea-sized amount to slightly damp skin.

Oily skin. Use half that amount, mainly on the cheeks. Our guide to night cream for oily skin explains why a thin layer works best.

Combination skin. Apply more on the cheeks and less on the forehead and nose.

Sensitive skin. Patch test first, and start with every second night for two weeks.

The step-by-step method is in how to apply night cream.

Using it in Indian weather

Korean creams were designed for cold, dry winters. In India, use a thinner layer in summer and during the monsoon, and the full amount in winter. If you sleep in an air-conditioned room, keep using it all year, because cooled air dries the skin overnight.

Avocado Korean Night Cream or Avocado Night Cream?

We make two avocado night creams with the same key ingredients. The Avocado Korean Night Cream comes in a 25 g jar and is the one most people start with. The Avocado Night Cream with Kojic Acid comes in a larger jar, which makes it better value if you use it every night.

You can compare them side by side in the Korean night cream guide and the avocado cream guide.

Pair it with

For a radiant-looking finish, alternate this cream with the Mirc Glow Glutathione Cream: one cream each night. For the daytime, the lighter Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream sits well under sunscreen. All three come together in the Korean Glass Skin Kit.

Good to know

  • Wear a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning.
  • Add one new product at a time.
  • Store the jar closed, away from heat and direct sunlight.
  • Check the use-before date on the pack.

You can read what to watch for in avocado night cream side effects, and get a full routine for your skin type from the skincare routine builder.

Frequently asked questions

What is MircGlow Avocado Korean Night Cream?

It is an overnight facial moisturiser with avocado, aloe vera, Vitamin B3 and Kojic Acid, formulated to support soft, smooth and radiant-looking skin.

What are the key ingredients?

The highlighted ingredients are avocado, aloe vera, Vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and Kojic Acid.

How do I use Avocado Korean Night Cream?

Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin as the final moisturising step of your evening skincare routine, avoiding the immediate eye area.

Can I use it every day?

It is designed for nighttime use. If you are new to the formula or use multiple active products, introduce it gradually and patch test first.

Can men use Avocado Korean Night Cream?

Yes. It is suitable for both women and men.

Is it made in Korea?

It is a Korean-inspired cream. It follows the Korean approach to texture and ingredients. Please see the pack for manufacturing details.

How long does a 25 g jar last?

With a pea-sized amount each night, around four to five weeks.

What is an avocado Korean night cream?

It is a night cream made in the style of Korean skincare: a moisturising last step at night for a hydrated, smooth, glass-skin look by morning, built around avocado.

Is avocado Korean night cream good for oily skin?

Yes, in a thin layer. Use half a pea-sized amount and focus on the cheeks. See avocado cream for oily skin.

Does it make skin fair or white?

No. It helps skin look more hydrated and even with regular use and sunscreen, but it does not change natural skin colour. Be careful of creams that promise whitening in days; read how to spot fake avocado whitening creams.

Avocado Korean Night Cream or Avocado Night Cream: which should I buy?

Choose the Korean Night Cream for most skin types and a more even-looking finish, and the 30 g Avocado Night Cream if your skin is dry or you want the best value per gram.
